contract.purpose: Install MAGRA from the GitHub repository with one auditable shell command.
contract.scope: Dependency checks, clone/update, selected ref checkout, build, local bin shim, dry-run, and PATH guidance.

interfaces.interface-2: MAGRA_REF, MAGRA_INSTALL_DIR, MAGRA_BIN_DIR, MAGRA_REPO_URL environment overrides

invariants.invariant-2: Node 22, npm, and git are checked before modifying the installation directory.
invariants.invariant-3: Repeated runs update the existing clone instead of creating duplicate installs.
